ucsc_intl.title: UCSC Admissions - International first-year admissions requirements

ucsc_cs.title: Baskin Engineering - Admission recommendations (Computer Science impacted)

test_policy.notes: UC campuses will not consider SAT/ACT in admissions or scholarships; scores can still be used for minimum eligibility, course placement and the Entry Level Writing requirement.

requirements.notes: Fee is $95 for international applicants; fee waivers are limited to US citizens, permanent residents and AB540-eligible applicants. Fall entry only for first-years.

deadlines.label: UC filing period closes
deadlines.notes: Filing period Oct 1 - Nov 30, 2026. No early plans. Decisions are released across March 1-31, 2027 (no campus-specific date published).

english_policy.waiver_notes: UCSC applies it when less than three years of secondary schooling was in English. Required if all secondary school was in a country where English is not the language of instruction. Alternatives accepted by UC: AP English Language or Literature 3-5, IB English A SL 6-7 / HL 5-7, ACT English Language Arts 24+, SAT Writing and Language 31+, or a C or better in a UC-transferable college English composition course. Exam must be taken by December of the final year. Individual campuses may set higher minimums.

english.notes: IELTS One Skill Retake not accepted

aid.notes: International students typically are not eligible for federal, state or university need-based aid. Considered automatically for the Undergraduate Deans' Award ($3,000-$25,000 per year for nonresident/international first-years) and the Regents Scholarship ($5,000 per year for up to four years); no separate application.

majors.notes: Page: CS is an impacted major; applicants must indicate CS on the application and be admitted as such; students admitted to another engineering major cannot transfer into CS after enrolling.

sat.note: UCSC publishes 'school code 004860' (College Board, used for AP/SAT reporting; shown as 4860 without leading zeros). UC does not consider SAT/ACT in admissions.

toefl.note: No undergraduate TOEFL code found on admissions pages. UC: self-report scores in the application; send official scores only to the campus where you enroll.

ielts.note: UCSC page: 'An institutional code is NOT required.' Have the test center send scores electronically to UC Santa Cruz, Office of Admissions.

tier_notes.business: No business major (Business Management Economics is an economics major).
